channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Courtney Lee | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Courtney Lee from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Courtney Lee
item.description:
Why did Noah put such an emphasis on recruiting Lee?

“I think Courtney is a guy who is going to do all the little things, whatever it takes to win games,”

Joakim Noah on Courtney Lee, Oct 27, 2016. Source: Basketball Insiders.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Jeff Green, Courtney Lee, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
“I’ve had a chance to watch them a couple times on TV. Obviously you see their big rookie [Kelly Olynyk]; you see [Jared] Sullinger, he’s taken the next step [and] I think he’s finally healthy; and then when they get Rondo back, this team has a bright future. Jeff Green, I expect him to emerge and really have a good season; Courtney Lee is comfortable out there; Avery [Bradley], it’s time for him to really step up. So they have some nice pieces to build with.”

Paul Pierce on Jeff Green, Courtney Lee, Kelly Olynyk, Oct 16, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Ray Allen, Courtney Lee
item.description:
Yesterday, Rondo was the latest to dismiss his former teammate, refusing to mention his name.

“A lot of people don’t know that Courtney, I think, was second behind No. 20 (Allen) last year in 3-point field goal percentage,”

Rajon Rondo on Ray Allen, Courtney Lee, Oct 1, 2012. Source: Boston Herald.
